name: Default
canonical_description: The initial value of a control before it is changed by the user.

name: DelayOutput
canonical_description: Set to true to delay action during text input.

name: DisplayMode
canonical_description: Values can be Edit, View, or Disabled. Configures whether the control allows user input (Edit), only displays data (View) or is disabled (Disabled).  In View mode, input controls such as Text input, Drop down, Date Picker will only display the text value and will not render any interactive elements or decorations.  This makes them suitable to be displayed in Forms or as readable output.

name: Items
canonical_description: The source of data that appears in a control such as a gallery, a list, or a chart.

name: OnChange
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user changes the value of a control (for example, by adjusting a slider).

name: OnSelect
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user taps or clicks a control.

name: Reset
canonical_description: Whether a control reverts to its default value.  Also see the Reset function.

name: Text
canonical_description: Text that appears on a control or that the user types into a control.

name: Tooltip
canonical_description: Explanatory text that appears when the user hovers over a control.

name: Value
canonical_description: The value of an input control.

name: Visible
canonical_description: Whether a control appears or is hidden.

name: Font
canonical_description: The name of the family of fonts in which text appears.

name: FontWeight
canonical_description: The weight of the text in a control: Bold, Semibold, Normal, or Lighter.

name: Italic
canonical_description: Whether the text in a control is italic.

name: Size
canonical_description: The font size of the text that appears on a control.

name: Strikethrough
canonical_description: Whether a line appears through the text that appears on a control.

name: Underline
canonical_description: Whether a line appears under the text that appears on a control.

name: Align
canonical_description: The location of text in relation to the horizontal center of its control.

name: LineHeight
canonical_description: The distance between, for example, lines of text or items in a list.

name: VerticalAlign
canonical_description: The location of text on a control in relation to the vertical center of that control.

name: BorderColor
canonical_description: The color of a control's border.

name: BorderStyle
canonical_description: Whether a control's border is Solid, Dashed, Dotted, or None.

name: BorderThickness
canonical_description: The thickness of a control's border.

name: Color
canonical_description: The color of text in a control.

name: Drop Shadow
canonical_description: Adds shadow effects around the control.

name: Fill
canonical_description: The background color of a control.

name: FocusedBorderColor
canonical_description: The color of a control's border when it has focus.

name: FocusedBorderThickness
canonical_description: The thickness of a control's border when it has focus.

name: DisabledBorderColor
canonical_description: The color of a control's border if the control's DisplayMode property is set to Disabled.

name: DisabledColor
canonical_description: The color of text in a control if its DisplayMode property is set to Disabled.

name: DisabledFill
canonical_description: The background color of a control if its DisplayMode property is set to Disabled.

name: HoverBorderColor
canonical_description: The color of a control's border when the user keeps the mouse pointer on that control.

name: HoverColor
canonical_description: The color of the text in a control when the user keeps the mouse pointer on it.

name: HoverFill
canonical_description: The background color of a control when the user keeps the mouse pointer on it.

name: PressedBorderColor
canonical_description: The color of a control's border when the user taps or clicks that control.

name: PressedColor
canonical_description: The color of text in a control when the user taps or clicks that control.

name: PressedFill
canonical_description: The background color of a control when the user taps or clicks that control.

name: SelectionColor
canonical_description: The text color of a selected item or items in a list or the color of the selection tool in a pen control.

name: SelectionFill
canonical_description: The background color of a selected item or items in a list or a selected area of a pen control.

name: X
canonical_description: The distance between the left edge of a control and the left edge of its parent container (screen if no parent container). For a Card control in a container that has multiple columns, this property determines the column in which the card appears.

name: Y
canonical_description: The distance between the top edge of a control and the top edge of the parent container (screen if no parent container). For a Card control in a container that has multiple rows, this property determines the row in which the card appears.

name: Height
canonical_description: The distance between a control's top and bottom edges.

name: AutoHeight
canonical_description: Whether a control automatically changes its height to fit the size of its contents, given a fixed width.

name: Width
canonical_description: The distance between a control's left and right edges.

name: WidthFit
canonical_description: Whether a control automatically grows horizontally to fill any empty space of a container control such as an Edit form control. If multiple cards have this property set to true, the space is divided between them. For more information, see Understand data form layout.

name: Padding
canonical_description: The distance between the text on an import or export button and the edges of that button.

name: PaddingBottom
canonical_description: The distance between text in a control and the bottom edge of that control.

name: PaddingLeft
canonical_description: The distance between text in a control and the left edge of that control.

name: PaddingRight
canonical_description: The distance between text in a control and the right edge of that control.

name: PaddingTop
canonical_description: The distance between text in a control and the top edge of that control.

name: RadiusBottomLeft
canonical_description: The degree to which the bottom-left corner of a control is rounded.

name: RadiusBottomRight
canonical_description: The degree to which the bottom-right corner of a control is rounded.

name: RadiusTopLeft
canonical_description: The degree to which the top-left corner of a control is rounded.

name: RadiusTopRight
canonical_description: The degree to which the top-right corner of a control is rounded.

name: BackgroundImage
canonical_description: The name of an image file that appears in the background of a screen.

name: Image
canonical_description: The name of the image that appears in an image, audio, or microphone control.

name: ImagePosition
canonical_description: The position (Fill, Fit, Stretch, Tile, or Center) of an image in a screen or a control if it isn't the same size as the image.

name: MaxAttachments
canonical_description: The maximum number of files the control accepts.

name: MaxAttachmentSize
canonical_description: The maximum allowed file size in MB for each new attachment. 1 MB here is 1,000,000 bytes (10<sup>6</sup> B) or 1,000 KB.

name: OnAddFile
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user adds a new file attachment.

name: OnRemoveFile
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user deletes an existing attachment.

name: OnUndoRemoveFile
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user restores a deleted attachment.

name: AccessibleLabel
canonical_description: Label for screen readers. Should describe the purpose of the attachments.

name: AddAttachmentText
canonical_description: The label text for the link used to add a new attachment.

name: [DropTargetBackgroundColor]
canonical_description: The color of the control's drop target background.

name: [DropTargetBorderColor]
canonical_description: The color of the control's drop target border.

name: [DropTargetBorderStyle]
canonical_description: Whether the control's drop target border is Solid, Dashed, Dotted, or None.

name: [DropTargetBorderThickness]
canonical_description: The thickness of the control's drop target border.

name: [DropTargetTextColor]
canonical_description: The color of the control's drop target text.

name: MaxAttachmentsText
canonical_description: The text that replaces the "Attach file" link when the control contains the maximum number of files allowed.

name: NoAttachmentsText
canonical_description: Informational text shown to the user when there are no files attached.

name: TabIndex
canonical_description: Keyboard navigation order in relation to other controls.

name: Loop
canonical_description: Whether an audio or video clip automatically starts over as soon as it finishes playing.

name: Media
canonical_description: An identifier for the clip that an audio or video control plays.

name: ShowControls
canonical_description: Whether an audio or video player shows, for example, a play button and a volume slider, and a pen control shows, for example, icons for drawing, erasing, and clearing.

name: AutoPause
canonical_description: Whether an audio or video clip automatically pauses if the user navigates to a different screen.

name: AutoStart
canonical_description: Whether an audio or video control automatically starts to play a clip when the user navigates to the screen that contains that control.

name: ClosedCaptionsUrl
canonical_description: Video control only.  URL of closed captions file in WebVTT format.  Both video and captions URLs must be HTTPS. Server hosting both video and captions file needs to be CORS enabled.

name: OnEnd
canonical_description: Actions to perform when an audio or video clip finishes playing.

name: OnPause
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user pauses the clip that an audio or video control is playing.

name: OnStart
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user starts to record with a microphone control.

name: Paused
canonical_description: True if a media playback control is currently paused, false otherwise.

name: Start
canonical_description: Whether an audio or video clip plays.

name: StartTime
canonical_description: The time after the start of an audio or video clip when the clip starts to play.

name: Time
canonical_description: A media control's current position.

name: Barcodes
canonical_description: Output property that contains a table of the barcodes scanned with two columns: Value, and Type. Value is the text value of the code that was scanned, while Type is the type of the code that was scanned.

name: OnScan
canonical_description: Actions to perform when a barcode is successfully scanned.

name: OnCancel
canonical_description: Actions to perform when a barcode scan is canceled by the user.

name: BarcodeType
canonical_description: The barcode type to scan. You can target multiple barcode types by concatenating them. Ex. `'Microsoft.BarcodeReader.BarcodeType'.Code128 & 'Microsoft.BarcodeReader.BarcodeType'.Code39`.  Default: Auto

name: Scanning mode
canonical_description: Whether to `Automatically scan` the first barcode detected in view, to allow the user to `Select to scan` which of the barcodes in view to scan, or to `Scan multiple` barcodes in a single session. On Windows, the barcode reader will always `Automatically scan`.

name: Scanning quality
canonical_description: The image quality the barcode reader scans at. A higher quality is good for small barcodes, but could lead to slow performance. On Windows, the barcode reader will always scan at the device's camera quality. Default: Automatic.

name: PreferFrontCamera
canonical_description: If enabled the barcode reader will default to using the front facing camera instead of the rear facing camera.

name: BeepOnScan
canonical_description: If enabled, the barcode reader will play a beep noise when a barcode is scanned.

name: VibrateOnScan
canonical_description: If enabled, the barcode reader will vibrate when a barcode is scanned.

name: Camera
canonical_description: On a device that has more than one camera, the numeric ID of the camera that the app uses for scanning barcodes.

name: ShowLiveBarcodeDetection
canonical_description: Whether visual cues are shown to indicate the status of barcode detection. Yellow rectangles represent areas that are being examined. A green line across a rectangle indicates successful barcode identification.

name: Stream
canonical_description: Automatically updated image based on the StreamRate property.

name: StreamRate
canonical_description: How often to update the image on the Stream property, in milliseconds.  This value can range from 100 (1/10th of a second) to 3,600,000 (1 hour).

name: AutoDisableOnSelect
canonical_description: Automatically disables the control while the OnSelect behavior is running.

name: ContentLanguage
canonical_description: The language of the control's content, if different from the control's container.

name: Pressed
canonical_description: True while a control is being pressed, false otherwise.

name: AvailableDevices
canonical_description: Table of the available cameras on the device.

name: OnStream
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the Stream property is updated.

name: Photo
canonical_description: The image captured when the user takes a picture.

name: Brightness
canonical_description: How much light the user is likely to perceive in an image.

name: Contrast
canonical_description: How easily the user can distinguish between similar colors in an image.

name: DataField
canonical_description: The name of the field within a record that this card displays and edits.

name: DisplayName
canonical_description: The user friendly name for a field in a data source.

name: Error
canonical_description: The user friendly error message to display for this field when validation fails.

name: Required
canonical_description: Whether a card, editing the field of a data source, must contain a value.

name: Update
canonical_description: The value to write back to the data source for a field.

name: Valid
canonical_description: Whether a Card or Edit form control contains valid entries, ready to be submitted to the data source.

name: CheckboxBackgroundFill
canonical_description: The background color of the box that surrounds the checkmark in a checkbox control.

name: CheckboxBorderColor
canonical_description: The color of the border that surrounds the checkmark in a checkbox control.

name: CheckboxSize
canonical_description: The width and height of the box that surrounds the checkmark in a checkbox control.

name: CheckmarkFill
canonical_description: The color of the checkmark in a checkbox control.

name: OnCheck
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the value of a checkbox or a toggle changes to true.

name: OnUncheck
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the value of a checkbox or a toggle changes to false.

name: DefaultSelectedItems
canonical_description: The initial selected item(s) before the user interacts with the control.

name: SelectedItems
canonical_description: List of selected items resulting from user interaction.

name: Selected
canonical_description: The last selected item resulting from user interaction.

name: SelectMultiple
canonical_description: Whether the user can select a single item or multiple items.

name: IsSearchable
canonical_description: Whether the user can search for items before selecting.

name: SearchFields
canonical_description: The data fields of the data source searched when user is entering text.

name: DisplayFields
canonical_description: List of fields shown for each item returned by the search.  Easiest to configure via the Data pane in the Properties option tab.

name: InputTextPlaceholder
canonical_description: Instructional text shown to end users when no items are selected.

name: OnNavigate
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user selects an item.

name: DefaultDate
canonical_description: The initial value of a date control unless the user changes it.

name: SelectedDate
canonical_description: The date currently selected in a date control.  This date is represented in local time.

name: Format
canonical_description: The text format in which the control shows the date and the user specifies the date. You can set this property to ShortDate (default) or LongDate to format dates based on the Language property of this control. You can also set this property to an expression, such as yyyy/mm/dd if you want the same format regardless of language. For example:

name: Language
canonical_description: Determines the language that's used to format dates, including names of months. If this property isn't specified, the user's device setting determines the language. Supported values include "EN-us" and "FR".

name: DateTimeZone
canonical_description: Whether to display the date in UTC or the user's Local time.

name: EndYear
canonical_description: The latest year to which the user can set value of a date-picker control.

name: IconFill
canonical_description: The foreground color of a the date picker icon.

name: IconBackground
canonical_description: The background color of a the date picker icon.

name: IsEditable
canonical_description: Whether the Date Picker text can be edited. If false, the date can only be changed by using the calendar.

name: StartOfWeek
canonical_description: The day of the week to display in the first day column of the date-picker control.

name: StartYear
canonical_description: The earliest year to which the user can set the value of a date-picker control.

name: AllowEmptySelection
canonical_description: Whether the control can have no selected items. When false, there will always be a selected item, which will initially be the Default or the first item.

name: ChevronBackground
canonical_description: The color behind the down arrow in a dropdown list.

name: ChevronFill
canonical_description: The color of the down arrow in a dropdown list.

name: SelectedText (Deprecated)
canonical_description: A string value that represents the selected item. Use Dropdown1.SelectedText.Value instead, replacing "Dropdown1" with drop-down control name in the app.

name: Data
canonical_description: The name of a collection that you want to export to a local file.

name: DataSource
canonical_description: The data source that contains the record that the user will show, edit, or create.

name: DefaultMode
canonical_description: The initial mode of the form control.  See the description of Mode below for the acceptable values and their meanings.

name: ErrorKind
canonical_description: If an error occurs when SubmitForm runs, the kind of error that occurred.

name: Item
canonical_description: The record in the DataSource that the user will show or edit.

name: LastSubmit
canonical_description: The last successfully submitted record, including any server generated fields.

name: Mode
canonical_description: The control is in Edit or New mode.

name: OnFailure
canonical_description: Actions to perform when a data operation has been unsuccessful.

name: OnReset
canonical_description: Actions to perform when an Edit form control is reset.

name: OnSuccess
canonical_description: Actions to perform when a data operation has been successful.

name: Unsaved
canonical_description: True if the Edit form control contains user changes that have not been saved.

name: Updates
canonical_description: The values to write back to the data source for a record loaded in a form control.

name: AllItems
canonical_description: Items that are loaded in the gallery. This may be less than the actual number of Items of the data source. More items may be loaded when the gallery is scrolled. AllItems also contains controls that are used in each gallery item.

name: AllItemsCount
canonical_description: Count of items that are loaded in the gallery. This may be less than the actual number of Items of the data source. More items may be loaded when the gallery is scrolled.

name: DelayItemLoading
canonical_description: Delay loading of items (rows) until after the screen first loads.

name: ItemAccessibleLabel
canonical_description: Label of each gallery item for screen readers. Should describe what each item is.

name: LoadingSpinnerColor
canonical_description: The fill color of the loading spinner.  Default is set to BorderColor.

name: NavigationStep
canonical_description: How far a gallery scrolls if its ShowNavigation property is set to true and the user selects a navigation arrow at either end of that gallery.

name: Selectable
canonical_description: Whether gallery items can be selected. When set to true, screen readers identify the gallery as a selectable list. And you select an item by selecting it. When set to false, screen readers identify the gallery as a regular list, and selecting an item doesn't select it.

name: ShowNavigation
canonical_description: Whether an arrow appears at each end of a gallery so that a user can scroll through the items in the gallery by selecting an arrow.

name: ShowScrollbar
canonical_description: Whether a scrollbar appears when the user hovers over a gallery.

name: TemplateFill
canonical_description: The background color of a gallery.

name: TemplatePadding
canonical_description: The distance between items in a gallery.

name: TemplateSize
canonical_description: The height of the template for a gallery in vertical/portrait orientation. Or the width of the template for a gallery in horizontal/landscape orientation. The minimum size is one.

name: Transition
canonical_description: The visual effect (Pop, Push, or None) when the user hovers over an item in a gallery.

name: WrapCount
canonical_description: Number of items shown per row or column based on horizontal or vertical layout.

name: HtmlText
canonical_description: Text that appears in an HTML text control and that may contain HTML tags.

name: ApplyEXIFOrientation
canonical_description: Whether to automatically apply the orientation specified in the EXIF data embedded with the image.

name: CalculateOriginalDimensions
canonical_description: Enables the OriginalHeight and OriginalWidth properties.

name: FlipHorizontal
canonical_description: Whether to flip the image horizontally before displaying it.

name: FlipVertical
canonical_description: Whether to flip the image vertically before displaying it.

name: ImageRotation
canonical_description: How to rotate the image before displaying it.  Values can be none, clockwise (CW) 90 degrees, counter-clockwise (CCW) 90 degrees and clockwise 180 degrees.

name: OriginalHeight
canonical_description: Original height of an image, enabled with the CalculateOriginalDimensions property.

name: OriginalWidth
canonical_description: Original width of an image, enabled with the CalculateOriginalDimensions property.

name: Transparency
canonical_description: The degree to which controls behind an image remain visible. Decimal values range from 0 to 1.  Where 0 is opaque, 0.5 is semi-transparent and 1 is transparent.

name: ItemPaddingLeft
canonical_description: The distance between text in a listbox and its left edge.

name: SelectedItemsText
canonical_description: Read-only. Represents a datatable of selected items text for a multiselect listbox.

name: Audio
canonical_description: The audio clip captured when the user records with the device's microphone.

name: Mic
canonical_description: Numeric ID of the microphone on a device that has more than one microphone.

name: OnStop
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the user stops recording with a microphone control.

name: Type
canonical_description: Output property that contains the type of the code that was scanned most recently.

name: FlashlightEnabled
canonical_description: Whether the flashlight is enabled automatically when the scanner is opened.

name: Document
canonical_description: The URL, enclosed in double-quotation marks, of a PDF file.

name: ActualZoom
canonical_description: The actual zoom of the control, which might differ from the zoom requested with the Zoom property.

name: CurrentFindText
canonical_description: The current search term that is in use.

name: CurrentPage
canonical_description: The number of the page in a PDF file that is actually being shown.

name: FindNext
canonical_description: Finds the next instance of FindText in the document.

name: FindPrevious
canonical_description: Finds the previous instance of FindText in the document.

name: FindText
canonical_description: The search term to look for in the document.

name: OnStateChange
canonical_description: Actions to perform when the state of the control changes.

name: Page
canonical_description: The number of the page that you want to show.

name: PageCount
canonical_description: The number of pages in a document.

name: Zoom
canonical_description: The percentage by which an image from a camera is magnified or the view of a file in a PDF viewer.

name: Input
canonical_description: Deprecated. Whether the input supports mouse, pen, or touch inputs.  Default value (7) supports all three.

name: SelectionThickness
canonical_description: The thickness of the selection tool for a pen-input control.

name: AllowNewAPI
canonical_description: Whether to use the new API when calling the Power BI service. Setting the value to True will allow the use of the new Power BI API (which isn't supported in mobile and some embedded scenarios, but allows some more advanced filtering). False will use the original API. Default value is false.

name: Dashboard
canonical_description: The Power BI dashboard where the tile comes from.

name: LoadPowerBIContent
canonical_description: When set to True, the Power BI content is loaded and shown. When set to False, the Power BI content is unloaded, which releases memory and optimizes performance.

name: PowerBIInteractions
canonical_description: When set to True, the Power BI content can be interacted with, but Power Apps OnSelect event won't trigger. When set to False, the tile can't be interacted with, but Power Apps OnSelect event will trigger when the tile is selected.

name: Tile
canonical_description: The name of the Power BI tile that you want to display.

name: Workspace
canonical_description: The Power BI workspace where the tile comes from.

name: TileUrl
canonical_description: The URL by which the tile is requested from the Power BI service. To add query string filtering to your URL, see the filtering section above.

name: Layout
canonical_description: Whether the options are laid out vertically or horizontally.

name: Max
canonical_description: The maximum value to which the user can set a slider or a rating.

name: RatingFill
canonical_description: The color of the stars in a rating control.

name: ReadOnly
canonical_description: Whether a user can change the value of a slider or rating control.

name: ShowValue
canonical_description: Whether a slider's or rating's value appears as the user changes that value or hovers over the control.

name: EnableSpellCheck
canonical_description: Whether the browser spell checker is enabled. This feature only checks spelling in the browser's default language. Power Apps for Windows doesn't support this property.

name: Name
canonical_description: The name of the screen.

name: OnHidden
canonical_description: The behavior of an app when the user navigates away from a screen. If the Disable non-blocking App.OnStart rule is enabled in app settings, this property may need to wait until App.OnStart is finished executing. By default, this setting is turned on.

name: OnVisible
canonical_description: The behavior of an app when the user navigates to a screen.  Use this property to set up variables and preload data used by the screen.  Use the App.OnStart property for set up once when the app is started. If the non-blocking App.OnStart is enabled, the Screen.OnVisible event can run parallel with it. As a result, it's recommended to refrain from relying on variables or collections that are initialized by App.OnStart, as they might not be fully initialized.

name: Orientation
canonical_description: The orientation of the screen. If its Width is greater than its Height, the orientation will be Layout.Horizontal; otherwise, it will be Layout.Vertical.

name: Min
canonical_description: The minimum value to which the user can set a slider.

name: HandleActiveFill
canonical_description: The color of the handle for a slider as the user changes its value.

name: HandleFill
canonical_description: The color of the handle (the element that changes position) in a toggle or slider control.

name: HandleHoverFill
canonical_description: The color of the handle in a slider when the user keeps the mouse pointer on it.

name: HandleSize
canonical_description: The diameter of the handle.

name: RailFill
canonical_description: The background color of the rectangle in a toggle control when its value is false or the color of the line to the right of the handle in a slider control.

name: RailHoverFill
canonical_description: When you hover on a toggle control or a slider, the background color of the rectangle in a toggle control when its value is false or the color of the line to the right of the handle in a slider control.

name: ValueFill
canonical_description: The background color of the rectangle in a toggle control when its value is true or the color of the line to the left of the handle in a slider control.

name: ValueHoverFill
canonical_description: When you keep the mouse pointer on a toggle control or a slider, the background color of the rectangle in a toggle control when its value is true or the color of the line to the left of the handle in a slider control.

name: Live
canonical_description: How a screen reader announces changes to the value of the label's Text property.

name: Overflow
canonical_description: Whether a scrollbar appears in a label if its Wrap property is set to true and the value of the control's Text property contains more characters than the control can show at one time.

name: Role
canonical_description: The semantic role of the label text, such as Heading 1. Doesn't change the style of the label but makes the output semantically correct for interpretation by screen readers.

name: Wrap
canonical_description: Whether the text should ever wrap to multiple lines.

name: Clear
canonical_description: Whether a text-input control shows an "X" that the user can tap or click to clear the contents of that control. Only works in SingleLine mode.

name: HintText
canonical_description: Light-grey text that appears in an input-text control if it's empty.

name: MaxLength
canonical_description: The number of characters that the user can type into a text-input control.

name: VirtualKeyboardMode
canonical_description: Type of virtual keyboard, text or numeric, that appears on an app user's touch screen. The Format property determines the default value. Device support varies. Devices that are running iOS must have at least version 12.2. The recommended version of Android is 9.0, and capabilities of numeric keyboards vary for Android devices. Windows 10 doesn't support this property.

name: `Duration`
canonical_description: How long a timer runs in milliseconds. The maximum is 24 hours expressed in milliseconds. Default is 60 seconds.

name: `OnTimerEnd`
canonical_description: Actions to perform when a timer finishes running.

name: `Repeat`
canonical_description: Whether a timer automatically restarts when it finishes running.

name: `Align`
canonical_description: The location of text in relation to the horizontal center of its control.

name: `AutoPause`
canonical_description: Whether the timer control automatically pauses if the user navigates to a different screen.

name: `AutoStart`
canonical_description: Whether the timer control automatically starts to play when the user navigates to the screen that contains that control.

name: `BorderColor`
canonical_description: The color of a control's border.

name: `BorderStyle`
canonical_description: Whether a control's border is `Solid`, `Dashed`, `Dotted`, or `None`.

name: `BorderThickness`
canonical_description: The thickness of a control's border.

name: `Color`
canonical_description: The color of text in a control.

name: `DisplayMode`
canonical_description: Whether the control allows user input (`Edit`), only displays data (`View`), or is disabled (`Disabled`).

name: `DisabledBorderColor`
canonical_description: The color of a control's border if the control's `DisplayMode` property is set to `Disabled`.

name: `DisabledColor`
canonical_description: The color of text in a control if its `DisplayMode` property is set to `Disabled`.

name: `DisabledFill`
canonical_description: The background color of a control if its `DisplayMode` property is set to `Disabled`.

name: `Fill`
canonical_description: The background color of a control.

name: `FocusedBorderColor`
canonical_description: The color of a control's border when the control is focused.

name: `FocusedBorderThickness`
canonical_description: The thickness of a control's border when the control is focused.

name: `Font`
canonical_description: The name of the family of fonts in which text appears.

name: `FontWeight`
canonical_description: The weight of the text in a control: `Bold`, `Semibold`, `Normal`, or `Lighter`.

name: `Height`
canonical_description: The distance between a control's top and bottom edges.

name: `HoverBorderColor`
canonical_description: The color of a control's border when the user keeps the mouse pointer on that control.

name: `HoverColor`
canonical_description: The color of the text in a control when the user keeps the mouse pointer on it.
